summary: POMDOCTOR Ltd, a Guangzhou-based pharmaceutical retail and internet hospital operator, furnished a Form 6-K containing its interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, plus related segment, share-incentive-plan and subsequent-event disclosures. The filing is a routine semi-annual reporting obligation for a foreign private issuer (the US equivalent of a domestic 10-Q), not a special-situation event. Disclosed items include an August 3, 2026 Guangzhou Rural bank facility and 2026 share incentive plan activity. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is stated.
